name: PDP Layout Configuration
description: Controls the product media/content columns, gallery presentation, sticky information, and product navigation.

attribute_definition_groups.name: PDP Layout Configuration
attribute_definition_groups.description: Controls the product media/content columns, gallery presentation, sticky information, and product navigation.

attribute_definitions.name: Desktop column ratio
attribute_definitions.description: Width allocated to product media and product information on desktop.

attribute_definitions.name: Media side
attribute_definitions.description: Places product media on the left or right on desktop. Mobile always shows media first.

attribute_definitions.name: Gallery presentation
attribute_definitions.description: Shows grid thumbnails, a horizontal thumbnail strip, or carousel controls only.

attribute_definitions.name: Sticky product information
attribute_definitions.description: Keeps the purchase column visible while the shopper scrolls product media on desktop.

attribute_definitions.name: Enable previous/next products
attribute_definitions.description: Shows links to adjacent products when the current item is available in the bounded primary-category navigation window.
